title: Pay rental bonds to the Commissioner
what: Pay each rental bond received to the Commissioner within the period allowed by regulation.

sources.title: Residential Tenancies Act 1995 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who receives an amount by way of a bond must pay the amount of the bond to the Commissioner in the manner and form approved by the Commissioner and accompanied by the information determined by the Commissioner within the period allowed by regulation
